headline: NYM @ PHI matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is NYM 4.06 at PHI 4.50, with a projected total of 8.56. Movement read: NRFI probability dropped -11.0%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Zack Wheeler has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Bo Bichette, Bryson Stott, Kyle Schwarber, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Brett Baty, MJ Melendez because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
